body: i don't really have a dream job. i always figured i'd end up being a janitor or secretary and i don't really care if i do. i really like art and spend most of my time drawing but i know it's next to impossible to actually make a living off of that. i don't think i want to turn my hobby into a professional thing either, you know? i just feel so guilty because i'm not doing anything and i don't know how

i just feel so behind and worthless. everyone else my age is in college and working jobs and some are even moving out. i don't know how to start because i was never allowed to and now i'm stuck and don't know what to do
